_comment: Recorded gh answers for the merge/auto-merge paths (2026-10-04). repo-* are `gh api repos/{r} --jq <readRepoMergeSettings jq>` for a repository with classic protection (agi-cli) and one with only a ruleset (agi-menu); protection-* are `.../branches/main/protection --jq .enforce_admins.enabled` and the stderr line gh prints for an unprotected branch. refusal-405 is GitHub's PUT pulls/{n}/merge answer while a required check is pending.
